name: ybex-ios
description: Ybex iPhone app (Capacitor shell). Carries the web build inside the app. See README.md.

scripts.web: cd .. && VITE_API_ORIGIN=${VITE_API_ORIGIN:-https://ybexapp.ai.studio} npx vite build && node scripts/ota-bundle.mjs
scripts.sync: npm run web && node scripts/set-builtin-version.mjs && npx cap sync ios
